$schema-note: Whitelist for scripts/release-plugin.sh. Only packages/* listed here may be published to a standalone repo. third-party/* is always refused.

dsh-client-ui-session-switcher.description: DSH session switcher: Ctrl+K command palette to create/archive/rename/search sessions, plus Ctrl+[/] cycling and VSCode-style shortcut layout.

dsh-external-dirs.description: DSH sidebar External Directories tab: browse read-only paths outside the session workspace and reuse the native file preview.

dsh-pdf-drop.description: Drop PDFs/documents onto the DSH Web composer: streamed upload into the current session workspace plus automatic @file mention insertion.

dsh-dev-probes.description: Read-only DSH plugin development probes: validate agent preset composition, verify client boot-graph presence, and preflight profile bundles before a restart.

dsh-science-map.description: Science Map for DSH: compiler and toolkit that turns a research reasoning flow into an evolving, gated evolution map.

dsh-note-board.description: DSH per-session Markdown note board as a third conversation tab: KaTeX rendering, incremental system-prompt injection, and adversarial audit verdicts.

dsh-plugin-repo-auditor.description: DSH native plugin: audit GitHub repos for fake stars, stargazer bot farms and hollow codebases using CMU StarScout heuristics, plus static supply-chain and sensitive-permission inspection.
